welcome:
Welcome to the Trivy CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated vulnerability scanner.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Scan and Fix Container Image Vulnerabilities

steps.instruction: Start by scanning the nginx:latest image for all vulnerabilities.
Too many results. Filter to only HIGH and CRITICAL severity.
Focus on vulnerabilities that have a fix available.
Get the results in JSON format for your CI pipeline.
Generate a CycloneDX SBOM to track all packages in the image.
List all packages installed in the image for auditing.
Set up a gate: fail the scan (exit code 1) if HIGH/CRITICAL vulns exist.
Now scan a hardened image to verify it passes the gate.
Scan the connected Kubernetes cluster for a summary report.
Get a detailed report of all vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
Scan your local Terraform/Kubernetes IaC configs for misconfigurations.
Filter IaC misconfigs to only CRITICAL and HIGH severity.
Scan the local filesystem for vulnerabilities, secrets, and misconfigs.
Generate an SBOM for the current project directory.
Scan a remote Git repository for vulnerabilities.
Check the installed Trivy version and verify the vulnerability DB is current.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  trivy image [image]            — Scan a container image for vulnerabilities
  trivy image --severity         — Filter by severity (CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM,LOW)
  trivy image --format           — Output format (table, json, sarif, cyclonedx)
  trivy image --ignore-unfixed   — Show only vulns with available fixes
  trivy image --exit-code        — Set exit code on vulnerability detection
  trivy image --list-all-pkgs    — List all installed packages
  trivy fs [path]                — Scan filesystem for vulns and secrets
  trivy config [path]            — Scan IaC files for misconfigurations
  trivy k8s --report             — Scan Kubernetes cluster
  trivy sbom --format            — Generate Software Bill of Materials
  trivy repo [url]               — Scan a remote Git repository
  trivy rootfs [path]            — Scan a root filesystem (e.g. container export)
  trivy plugin list              — List installed plugins
  trivy version                  — Show version and DB info
  trivy --cache-dir [path]       — Set custom cache directory

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
